answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, published publicly on failure, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Reaching the garden of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the zephyr of a task receipt, and the tundra is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
